name: Maya Okafor
bio: Maya has coached barbell strength for eleven years and competed in powerlifting for most of them, and wrote the programming every PowerHouse class runs on.
The coaching is quiet and specific. Expect one cue at a time, and a lot of attention on the warm-up sets nobody else watches.
imageAlt: Maya Okafor standing with arms crossed in the mobility corner

name: Daniel Reyes
bio: Daniel came to coaching from competitive weightlifting and still trains the snatch most mornings before the 6:00 class.
Daniel breaks the lifts into positions you can feel, so the fast parts stop being a guess.
imageAlt: Daniel Reyes resting both forearms on a barbell beside the gym windows

name: Priya Nair
bio: Priya runs Strength foundations and most of the free intro sessions. If you have never touched a barbell, Priya is probably the first coach you will meet.
Priya is good at finding the version of a lift that works for your body today, and the path to the full version.
imageAlt: Priya Nair leaning on a barbell in the squat rack, smiling

name: Tom Becker
bio: Tom spent six years working alongside physical therapists before moving to the gym floor, and now runs Mobility and recovery and helps members train around old injuries.
Tom will not diagnose you, but will help you keep training while you get things looked at.
imageAlt: Tom Becker leaning on a squat rack by the gym windows, one hand chalked
